name: .NET API CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DOCKERHUB_USERNAME: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
      OCTOPUS_SERVER: ${{ vars.OCTOPUS_SERVER }}

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup .NET 8
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

    - name: Restore NuGet packages
      run: dotnet restore Employee-Management-Microservice/Employee-Management-Microservice.csproj

    - name: Build solution
      run: dotnet build Employee-Management-Microservice/Employee-Management-Microservice.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore

    - name: Run unit tests
      run: dotnet test Employee-Management-Microservice/Employee-Management-Microservice.csproj --no-build --verbosity normal

    - name: Publish build artifacts
      run: dotnet publish Employee-Management-Microservice/Employee-Management-Microservice.csproj --configuration Release --no-build --output ./publish

    - name: Log in to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        username: ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Build Docker image
      run: docker build -t ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/employeemicroservice:${{ github.sha }} .

    - name: Push Docker image to Docker Hub
      run: docker push ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/employeemicroservice:${{ github.sha }}

    - name: Install Octopus CLI
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y curl
        curl -sL https://github.com/OctopusDeploy/OctopusCLI/releases/latest/download/OctopusTools.linux-x64.tar.gz | tar xz
        sudo mv octo /usr/local/bin/

    - name: Create Octopus package file (Docker image info)
      run: |
        echo "DockerImage: ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/employeemicroservice:${{ github.sha }}" > employeemicroservice.docker.txt
        tar -czvf employeemicroservice.${{ github.sha }}.tar.gz employeemicroservice.docker.txt

    - name: Push package to Octopus Deploy
      env:
        OCTOPUS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OCTOPUS_API_KEY }}
        OCTOPUS_SERVER: ${{ env.OCTOPUS_SERVER }}
        OCTOPUS_SPACE: ${{ secrets.OCTOPUS_SPACE }}
      run: |
        octo push \
          --package employeemicroservice.${{ github.sha }}.tar.gz \
          --replace-existing \
          --server $OCTOPUS_SERVER \
          --apiKey $OCTOPUS_API_KEY \
          --space "$OCTOPUS_SPACE"

    - name: Create and deploy release in Octopus Deploy
      env:
        OCTOPUS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OCTOPUS_API_KEY }}
        OCTOPUS_SERVER: ${{ env.OCTOPUS_SERVER }}
        OCTOPUS_SPACE: ${{ secrets.OCTOPUS_SPACE }}
      run: |
        octo create-release \
          --project "Employee Management Microservice" \
          --releaseNumber "1.0.${{ github.run_number }}" \
          --deployTo "Production" \
          --packageVersion "1.0.${{ github.run_number }}" \
          --server $OCTOPUS_SERVER \
          --apiKey $OCTOPUS_API_KEY \
          --space "$OCTOPUS_SPACE"
